title: Exact restriction compositors and their localization formulas
statement:
For additive exact functors S:C→B, R:B→A, U:C→A and an isomorphism η:S⋅R≅U, the canonical comparison D(S)⋅D(R)≅D(U), constructed from the exact localization compositor and D(η), commutes with the inverse and forward cochain factorizations. For R:A→A identified with the identity, its derived unit comparison and its inverse satisfy the analogous factorization formulas.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
variable {A B C : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Category C]
  [Abelian A] [Abelian B] [Abelian C]
  [HasDerivedCategory A] [HasDerivedCategory B] [HasDerivedCategory C]
  (S : C ⥤ B) (R : B ⥤ A) (U : C ⥤ A)
  [S.Additive] [R.Additive] [U.Additive]
  [PreservesFiniteLimits S] [PreservesFiniteColimits S]
  [PreservesFiniteLimits R] [PreservesFiniteColimits R]
  [PreservesFiniteLimits U] [PreservesFiniteColimits U]
theorem exactDerivedRestrictionComposition_inv_factors (η : S ⋙ R ≅ U)
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    R.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
      R.mapDerivedCategory.map (S.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app K) ≫
      (exactDerivedRestrictionComposition S R U η).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) =
    DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex η (.up ℤ)).hom.app K) ≫
      U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app K
```

proof.text: Expand the derived comparison as the inverse exact-functor compositor followed by localization of η. Its factorization equations cancel the two successive exact factorization isomorphisms. The identity comparison formula follows through the homotopy quotient; all quotient comparison components are identities. Cancel forward and inverse unit factors to obtain the inverse formula.
